problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category 'vulkan_device_error' (and/or 'nvidia_permission'), OR analyze_crash_report -> crash_causes scored highest as 'gpu_driver_crash'. Cross-reference system_info.gpu_model / gpu_driver (here RTX 4080 SUPER, 610.47.0) to report the exact driver in the guidance.
problems.manualFix: 1) Install the latest (or a known-good prior) NVIDIA Studio driver and do a clean install. 2) Remove any GPU overclock/undervolt (MSI Afterburner) — even factory OC can trigger device-lost under Vulkan. 3) Lower Texture Quality and disable per-pixel/SSAO-heavy effects to reduce VRAM pressure. 4) Remove third-party injectors/overlays (ReShade, GamePP, Afterburner OSD). 5) As a test, try the OpenGL-free path is not available in XP12, so confirm by reverting one variable at a time.
problems.symptom: X-Plane freezes then closes to desktop (often with a 'device lost' / VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST style failure), frequently while loading heavy scenery or after long sessions. Common on NVIDIA cards, especially with overclocks or after a driver update.
problems.title: Vulkan device lost / GPU driver crash

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category 'third_party_blocked' (ReShade/GamePP). Corroborate with filesystem presence: ReShade.ini + reshade-shaders folder in the X-Plane root (confirmed present in tested install).
problems.manualFix: Quit X-Plane. Remove the injector from the X-Plane root: delete/move ReShade DLL (e.g. dxgi.dll/d3d11.dll/vulkan-1.dll proxy), ReShade.ini, and reshade-shaders. For GamePP, fully exit/uninstall the GamePP process. Disable Afterburner/RTSS overlay. Relaunch and confirm the log no longer reports 'third_party_blocked'. Doctor must only guide here — never delete third-party files automatically.
problems.symptom: Instant CTD on launch, black screen, or random in-flight crashes. Laminar explicitly blocks injected DLLs (ReShade, GamePP, FPS/overlay tools) because they hook the Vulkan/graphics pipeline and are a top cause of unexplained CTDs.
problems.title: ReShade / GamePP injector blocked or crashing

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains 'out_of_memory', 'heavy_memory_pressure', or 'severe_texture_downscale', AND/OR analyze_crash_report -> crash_causes top score 'memory_exhaustion'. total_high count rises when these stack.
problems.manualFix: 1) Lower Texture Quality one step (biggest VRAM saver). 2) Reduce World/Objects and Reflections detail. 3) Disable or trim large ortho/photoscenery tiles overlapping your flight area. 4) Reduce number of simultaneously enabled scenery packs. 5) Close other VRAM/RAM-hungry apps (browsers). Re-check the log after one change at a time.
problems.symptom: Crash or hard freeze while loading or flying over dense ortho/photo scenery or many add-ons; textures visibly blur out (downscaling) shortly before the crash. Typical on installs with large ortho coverage or many high-res addons.
problems.title: Out-of-memory / heavy memory pressure crash

problems.detect: analyze_crash_report -> crash_causes top score 'plugin_crash' with the offending module visible in stack frames / loaded_plugins, corroborated by analyze_xplane_log 'plugin_error' or 'plugin_assert'. Map the named plugin against scan_plugins to identify the owning addon.
problems.manualFix: 1) Identify the plugin from the crash stack (Gizmo64, SASL, XLua, etc.). 2) Update it via check_plugins_updates / the aircraft vendor. 3) If no update, temporarily disable that addon's plugin folder and retest. 4) Report the crash dump to the developer. On a beta XP build, an outdated plugin is the single most likely culprit.
problems.source: analyze_crash_report (plugin_crash, stack frames, loaded_plugins), analyze_xplane_log (plugin_error/plugin_assert), scan_plugins / check_plugins_updates
problems.symptom: CTD tied to a specific aircraft or plugin, often right after loading a flight or interacting with an FMC/menu. Log shows plugin errors/asserts before the crash.
problems.title: Plugin-caused crash (Gizmo64/SASL/XLua etc.)

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category 'duplicate_plugin' (and the sample_line names the duplicated DLL). Confirm install locations via scan_plugins.
problems.manualFix: Quit X-Plane. From the duplicate paths reported in the log, remove the redundant copy (keep the newest version, usually the global Resources/plugins one) and delete the stale duplicate. Doctor guides the user to the exact folders but does not delete addon files itself.
problems.symptom: Random instability, doubled menu entries, or CTD when two copies of the same plugin (e.g. XPLM helper, a global plugin also bundled per-aircraft) load simultaneously.
problems.title: Duplicate plugin loaded twice

problems.autoFix: clean_output_items(items: [<shadercache entry from scan_output_cleanup_items>])  // only the shadercache category, not logs
problems.detect: Heuristic: analyze_xplane_log shows a crash_detected / abnormal end during shader compile or load phase OR vulkan_device_error near startup, AND scan_output_cleanup_items reports a populated Output/shadercache (227MB in the tested install). Strengthen the signal when gpu_driver changed since the cache was written (NEW: compare shadercache mtime vs current driver — optional).
problems.manualFix: Quit X-Plane (Doctor blocks this while is_xplane_running is true). Delete the contents of Output/shadercache. X-Plane rebuilds it on next launch (first load will be slower). Safe and self-healing, but confirm because it forces a one-time recompile.
problems.symptom: After a driver update or a crash, X-Plane hangs on a black/blank screen during load or CTDs early. A stale Vulkan shader cache that no longer matches the current driver is a frequent cause.
problems.title: Corrupt shader cache — blank screen / hang on load

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains 'dsf_error' or 'scenery_error' with the failing .dsf path in sample_line/line_numbers. Map the path to a pack via get_scenery_manager_data entries[].
problems.manualFix: Identify the failing tile from the log path. Re-download/reinstall that scenery tile, or remove the corrupt .dsf and let a base tile load. For ortho, re-run the tile generator. Doctor points to the exact file but does not delete scenery automatically.
problems.symptom: X-Plane freezes or crashes while loading a specific area; the log shows DSF/scenery read errors just before the hang. Often a partially-downloaded ortho tile or a mesh built for an older XP version.
problems.title: Corrupt/incompatible DSF causing hang or CTD on load

problems.autoFix: sort_scenery_packs(xplanePath, lockedFolderNames: <user-locked entries, default []>)
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data -> needs_sync == true (and/or non-empty tile_overlaps / duplicate_tiles_count). This is the canonical signal that the ini ordering diverges from correct priority.
problems.manualFix: If you prefer manual control, reorder scenery_packs.ini so airports/overlays sit above libraries and mesh/ortho sit at the bottom. The one-click Sort does this safely and is fully reversible by re-sorting.
problems.symptom: Missing airports/objects, overlapping scenery 'fighting', or odd load behavior because higher-priority packs are listed below the base mesh/library packs.
problems.title: scenery_packs.ini out of priority order

problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data -> missing_deps_count > 0 and per-entry missing_libraries[] populated. Resolve names via lookup_library_links_remote.
problems.manualFix: Doctor lists each missing library with a resolved download link (lookup_library_links_remote). User downloads and installs each into Custom Scenery, then re-sorts. Not auto-installed because it fetches third-party content.
problems.symptom: Red/white missing-object markers, blank buildings, or load stalls because a custom airport references a library (e.g. OpenSceneryX, MisterX, R2) that isn't installed.
problems.title: Missing scenery library dependency

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> system_info.xplane_version indicates a beta/release-candidate suffix (e.g. '12.4.3-b4', confirmed in tested install). Reinforce with analyze_xplane_log categories 'deprecated_dataref' / 'missing_plugin_support'.
problems.manualFix: If you value stability over new features, opt out of the beta in the X-Plane installer/Steam betas and update to the current stable build. If staying on beta, keep all plugins/addons updated and expect occasional instability — report reproducible crashes to Laminar.
problems.symptom: More frequent CTDs, plugin incompatibilities, and 'deprecated dataref' warnings than on stable, because addons/plugins haven't caught up to the beta SDK.
problems.title: Running a BETA X-Plane build

problems.detect: analyze_crash_report newest .dmp mtime is OLDER than the current Log.txt mtime (tested install: .dmp dated May 6, log ended normally later). The command's skipDateCheck flag governs whether to surface it; default should down-rank a stale dump to info.
problems.manualFix: Treat as historical context, not an active crash. If you want a clean slate, you may delete the old .dmp (32MB) to reclaim space, but it harms nothing to leave it. Doctor only guides deletion; it never removes .dmp files automatically.
problems.source: analyze_crash_report (.dmp mtime vs Log.txt mtime, skipDateCheck)
problems.symptom: Doctor would otherwise alarm the user about a crash dump that predates the current session — the .dmp is from a past issue that may already be fixed, not the current run.
problems.title: Minidump older than current log (already resolved?)

problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category 'runloop_backlog' (sample_line typically names the offending plugin/callback). Correlate the named module with scan_plugins.
problems.manualFix: Identify the plugin named in the backlog log line, update it, or disable it to confirm it's the cause. Reduce AI traffic / weather-injector polling if those are implicated. Persistent backlogs should be reported to the plugin developer.
problems.symptom: Severe stutters or apparent freezes where the sim briefly stops responding; can be mistaken for a crash. A plugin or callback is overrunning the flight-loop.
problems.title: Run-loop backlog / long frame hangs
X-Plane beta build detected
problems.symptom: Running X-Plane beta (e.g., 12.4.3-b4) which may have stability issues and addon incompatibilities
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log(xplanePath).system_info.xplane_version contains '-b' suffix (beta) or '-rc' suffix (release candidate). Parse version string from Log.txt first line.
problems.manualFix: Consider switching to stable channel: Open X-Plane, go to Settings > General > Updates, change update channel from Beta to Stable. Back up Custom Data/scenery_packs.ini before updating. Note: beta builds provide early access to new features but may cause plugin crashes or rendering issues.

problems.title: Navdata cycle expired or expiring soon
problems.symptom: AIRAC cycle is outdated, causing incorrect SIDs/STARs, wrong frequencies, and mismatched charts in flight planning
problems.detect: scan_navdata(xplanePath).entries[].airac and cycle_info.txt validity dates. Parse validity end date from Custom Data/cycle_info.txt (Navigraph format: 'valid DD/MMM/YYYY - DD/MMM/YYYY'). Compare against today (2026-06-07). Flag if expired or expires within 7 days.
problems.manualFix: Update navdata: Open Navigraph FMS Data Manager (or your provider's updater), download the latest AIRAC cycle, and install to X-Plane 12 Custom Data. Active subscriptions receive monthly updates (typically 4th Thursday of each month).
problems.source: scan_navdata entries[].airac + NEW: parse cycle_info.txt validity dates

problems.title: Addon updates available
problems.symptom: Outdated aircraft/plugins may lack compatibility with latest X-Plane version, miss bug fixes, or have degraded performance
problems.detect: check_aircraft_updates(xplanePath) + check_plugins_updates(xplanePath) return has_update=true entries. Count total updatable items across SkunkCrafts, X-Updater, and Zibo providers.
problems.autoFix: Navigate user to Management > Aircraft/Plugins page where they can review and apply updates individually. Doctor displays count and links.
problems.manualFix: Go to Management page, review available updates, click Update button for each addon. Read changelogs before updating. Some updates may require X-Plane restart.

problems.title: Gateway airport updates available
problems.symptom: Outdated airports may have incorrect taxiway layouts, missing parking stands, or misaligned runways affecting ground operations
problems.detect: gateway_check_updates(xplanePath) returns entries with has_update=true. These represent scenery gateway airports with newer community submissions.
problems.autoFix: Navigate user to Scenery > Gateway page. Updates are individually confirmable (user picks which airports to update).
problems.manualFix: Go to Scenery > Gateway page, review airports with updates, select desired airports, click Update. Gateway updates replace Custom Scenery airport files with latest community-approved versions.

problems.title: XFast Manager update available
problems.symptom: Running outdated XFast Manager version may miss new features, bug fixes, or compatibility improvements for latest X-Plane builds
problems.detect: check_for_updates(manual=false, include_pre_release=false) returns available=true. Compare current_version vs remote latest_version from Vercel endpoint.
problems.autoFix: Prompt user with update dialog showing changelog and version. Tauri updater downloads, verifies signature, and installs on user confirmation. Restart required.
problems.manualFix: Click 'Update Now' in the notification or go to Settings > About > Check for Updates. The app will download and install the update, then restart automatically.

problems.title: X-Plane update channel uncertain
problems.symptom: Cannot determine if running stable/beta/dev build from version string; may be on unexpected channel causing surprise updates
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log(xplanePath).system_info.xplane_version lacks clear suffix (no '-b', '-rc', '-r' suffix) but version is unusually high/low for stable. E.g., 12.1.x series when 12.4.x is current stable suggests stale install.
problems.manualFix: Check X-Plane Settings > General > Updates to see configured channel (Stable/Beta). Stable channel typically shows '-r' suffix (e.g., 12.1.0-r1), beta shows '-b', pure dev builds may lack suffix. If unsure, check Laminar Research website for current stable version number.

problems.title: Conflicting addon updater configurations detected
problems.symptom: Addon has both SkunkCrafts .cfg and X-Updater profile; competing updaters may corrupt installation or fight over versions
problems.detect: NEW: scan_plugins/scan_aircraft folders for presence of both 'skunkcrafts_updater.cfg' and X-Updater profile files (JSON with 'x-updater' fields) in same folder. Rust addon_updater.rs already enforces mutual exclusion via enforce_obfuscated_xupdater_lock, but detection before update attempt is preferable.
problems.manualFix: Choose one updater system per addon. Delete either skunkcrafts_updater.cfg or the X-Updater profile JSON from the addon folder. If using SkunkCrafts Updater, delete X-Updater files. If using X-Updater client, delete SkunkCrafts .cfg. Do not run both updaters on the same addon simultaneously.
problems.source: NEW: dual scan for skunkcrafts_updater.cfg + X-Updater profile in same folder

problems.title: Zibo 737 major version update available
problems.symptom: Major Zibo update requires full reinstall (not patch); continuing with old major version misses significant systems/features and may have unpatched bugs
problems.detect: check_aircraft_updates(xplanePath) for Zibo entries where remote_version major differs from local_version (e.g., local 4.04.x vs remote 4.05.x). Zibo updater detects this via ZiboInstallMode::MajorClean in plan_zibo_update.
problems.autoFix: Execute Zibo update via execute_aircraft_update. Zibo updater automatically handles MajorClean mode (deletes old version, installs base package, applies follow-up patch). Requires ~1-2GB download.
problems.manualFix: Go to Management > Aircraft, locate Zibo 737, click Update. Major updates delete the old version and perform clean install (preserves your liveries if stored separately). Download size is typically larger for major updates (~1-2GB vs ~50-200MB for patches).

problems.title: Multiple navdata providers installed
problems.symptom: Conflicting navdata (e.g., Navigraph + Aerosoft) can cause X-Plane to use mismatched data, leading to frequency/routing errors and FMS confusion
problems.detect: scan_navdata(xplanePath).entries.length > 1. Multiple cycle.json files in Custom Data subfolders (e.g., GNS430/navdata, GNS530/navdata, separate Navigraph folder). X-Plane only uses one actively.
problems.manualFix: Choose one navdata provider. Typical structure: one cycle.json at Custom Data root or one subfolder (not multiple). If you have multiple, delete the unwanted provider's folder(s) in Custom Data, keeping only your primary subscription (usually Navigraph). Reinstall your chosen provider cleanly if unsure.

problems.title: X-Plane version appears outdated
problems.symptom: Running old X-Plane stable version misses critical bug fixes, Vulkan/Metal performance improvements, and may lack compatibility with recent addons
problems.detect: NEW: parse analyze_xplane_log(xplanePath).system_info.xplane_version and compare major.minor.patch against known current stable (as of June 2026, 12.1.x is current stable). If detected version is 12.0.x or older, flag as stale. Normalize version via gateway.rs normalize_xplane_version_token logic.
problems.manualFix: Update X-Plane: Launch X-Plane, go to Settings > General > Updates, click Check for Updates. Ensure update channel is set to Stable. Download and install the update (requires restart). Backup Custom Data and scenery_packs.ini first. Major updates (e.g., 12.0 to 12.1) may reset some settings.
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log system_info.xplane_version + NEW: version comparison logic

problems.title: X-Updater credentials not configured
problems.symptom: Cannot check or download updates for X-Updater-managed addons (e.g., ToLiss, FlightFactor) without authentication
problems.detect: NEW: get_addon_updater_credentials() returns empty/null for X-Updater email/password, AND scan_plugins/scan_aircraft detect X-Updater profile files present. Indicates updater needs auth but isn't configured.
problems.manualFix: Go to Management page, click the gear icon, select 'X-Updater Credentials', enter your store.x-plane.org email and password. These credentials are stored locally and used to authenticate update checks for X-Updater-enabled addons.
problems.source: NEW: get_addon_updater_credentials + presence of X-Updater profiles

problems.title: Beta addon version on stable X-Plane
problems.symptom: Beta addon versions (often labeled 'experimental' or 'dev' in version strings) may exhibit instability on stable X-Plane builds or lack expected performance
problems.detect: NEW: scan_plugins/scan_aircraft version_info.version contains 'beta', 'dev', 'exp', 'alpha', or 'rc' (case-insensitive) AND analyze_xplane_log(xplanePath).system_info.xplane_version does NOT contain '-b' suffix (is stable). Mismatch indicates experimental addon on production sim.
problems.manualFix: Check addon developer's website or updater for a stable release version. If running stable X-Plane, prefer stable addon releases. If you intentionally installed a beta addon for testing, ignore this warning. Some developers only release betas during X-Plane beta cycles.
problems.source: NEW: cross-check scan_plugins/scan_aircraft version_info vs xplane_version beta status

problems.title: scenery_packs.ini not sorted correctly
problems.symptom: Custom airports don't appear, ortho tiles flicker, libraries not loading. X-Plane requires specific order: airports before overlays before ortho before mesh before libraries.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).needs_sync === true
problems.autoFix: sort_scenery_packs(xplanePath, []) — rewrites scenery_packs.ini in correct priority order (Airport > Overlay > Ortho > Mesh > Library)
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager tab and click 'Apply Order' to rewrite scenery_packs.ini.

problems.title: Overlapping DSF mesh tiles
problems.symptom: Z-fighting / flickering terrain textures where two mesh packages cover the same lat/lon tile. X-Plane tries to render both, causing visual artifacts.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).duplicate_tiles_count > 0 OR tile_overlaps map is non-empty. Per-entry: entry.duplicate_tiles[] lists conflicting packages.
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, find packages flagged with duplicate tiles, disable the lower-priority mesh or move XPME_ (AutoOrtho) packages above static ortho. For Ortho4XP conflicts with default Global Scenery, disable the Global Scenery entry.

problems.title: Duplicate airport definitions
problems.symptom: Multiple scenery packages define the same ICAO airport code. Only the highest-priority one loads; others are silently ignored, wasting disk space and causing confusion.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).duplicate_airports_count > 0. Per-entry: entry.duplicate_airports[] lists other packages with same airport_id.
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, review packages with duplicate airports, disable or uninstall the unwanted version. Higher entries in the list take priority.

problems.title: Missing scenery library dependencies
problems.symptom: Scenery package requires library.txt exports (OpenSceneryX, SAM, MisterX, etc.) that aren't installed. Objects/jetways won't appear; scenery looks incomplete or static.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).missing_deps_count > 0. Per-entry: entry.missing_libraries[] lists library names not found in index.
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, find packages with missing libraries icon. Click to see required library names, then install them (lookup_library_links_remote can resolve download URLs for common libraries).

problems.title: Global Airports disabled (no default airports)
problems.symptom: X-Plane's 30,000+ default airports are disabled. Only custom scenery airports will load; most of the world becomes empty grass fields with no runways.
problems.detect: NEW: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).entries[] → find entry with folder_name === '*GLOBAL_AIRPORTS*' → check entry.enabled === false
problems.autoFix: NEW: set_global_airports_enabled(xplanePath, true) — re-enable default airports in scenery_packs.ini
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, find 'Global Airports' entry, click the toggle to enable it.

problems.title: Global Airports in wrong position (XP12)
problems.symptom: In X-Plane 12, Global Airports should sit between Overlays and Libraries (priority 5). If positioned too high, custom airports are overridden; too low, library objects won't load on default airports.
problems.detect: NEW: X-Plane version === 12 AND get_scenery_manager_data → *GLOBAL_AIRPORTS* entry.category !== 'Overlay' (expected for XP12 default position per XPLANE_12_GLOBAL_AIRPORTS_PRIORITY=5 in scenery_packs_manager.rs)
problems.autoFix: reset_global_airports_position_to_default(xplanePath) — moves Global Airports to default XP12 position (between overlays and libraries)
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, drag Global Airports to position between Overlays and Libraries, then Apply Order.
problems.source: NEW: Global Airports metadata + XP version detection

problems.title: xOrganizer detected (competing scenery manager)
problems.symptom: xOrganizer is another scenery manager that modifies scenery_packs.ini. Running both tools simultaneously can cause order conflicts and lost manual edits.
problems.detect: NEW: fs.exists(xplanePath + '/Resources/plugins/xOrganizer') OR scenery_packs.ini contains comments with 'xOrganizer' signature
problems.manualFix: Choose one scenery manager to use consistently. If using XFast Manager, consider disabling or removing xOrganizer plugin to avoid conflicts. After switching, rebuild the scenery index.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem check for xOrganizer plugin

problems.title: Ortho/mesh scenery positioned above default Global Scenery
problems.symptom: Ortho4XP, AutoOrtho (XPME_*), or custom mesh packages positioned higher than Global Scenery can cause airports to disappear or terrain to override airport surfaces.
problems.detect: NEW: get_scenery_manager_data → entries[].category === 'Mesh' with sort_order < *GLOBAL_AIRPORTS*.sort_order (mesh should be lower priority than airports)
problems.autoFix: sort_scenery_packs(xplanePath, []) — reorders mesh below airports
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, move mesh/ortho packages (including zOrtho4XP_*, XPME_*) below airports and Global Airports, then Apply Order.

problems.title: Airport flatten overrides need re-apply
problems.symptom: X-Plane Gateway airports with custom flatten overrides may drift after Gateway updates. Runways become bumpy or intersect terrain.
problems.detect: airport_flatten_list_overrides(xplanePath).overrides[] → any entry with drifted === true
problems.autoFix: airport_flatten_apply_all_drifted(xplanePath) — re-applies flatten overrides to drifted airports
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, find airports with 'Flatten Drifted' status, click 'Re-apply Flatten' to regenerate apt.dat with correct elevation overrides.

problems.title: Unrecognized scenery packages enabled
problems.symptom: Folders in Custom Scenery that don't match any known scenery pattern (no apt.dat, dsf, or library.txt) are enabled in scenery_packs.ini. They slow down X-Plane startup and may cause parser errors if malformed.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).entries[] → filter category === 'Unrecognized' AND enabled === true. Count > 0.
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, filter by Unrecognized category, review the packages. If they are temporary extraction folders or non-scenery data, disable them. If they are valid scenery misclassified, they will still work when disabled (XFast Manager only indexes recognized scenery).

problems.title: DSF terrain file errors in Log.txt
problems.symptom: X-Plane Log.txt shows DSF load errors. Corrupted or malformed terrain files cause missing scenery tiles, black terrain, or simulator pauses during tile loads.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log(xplanePath).issues[] → filter category === 'dsf_error' OR category === 'scenery_error'. Count > 0.
problems.manualFix: Check Log.txt for specific DSF file paths in error messages. Identify the scenery package, then re-download or disable it. For Ortho4XP, regenerate the affected tiles. For AutoOrtho, clear the cache and re-download.

problems.title: Excessive enabled scenery packages
problems.symptom: Too many enabled scenery packages (>100) significantly slow X-Plane startup and can cause memory pressure. X-Plane scans all enabled packages on launch.
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data(xplanePath).enabled_count > 100
problems.manualFix: Open Scenery Manager, audit your scenery library. Disable regional scenery you don't fly in (e.g., if you fly only North America, disable European/Asian scenery). Consolidate overlapping ortho tiles. Keep only the airports you actively use.

problems.title: AIRAC cycle expired or expiring soon
problems.symptom: FMS shows outdated procedures, approaches, SIDs/STARs. Navigation database may not reflect current real-world airspace changes. Flight planning may reference obsolete waypoints or airways.
problems.detect: scan_navdata returns cycle.json with cycle/airac fields. Frontend airac.ts utility getCurrentAiracCycle() + parseAiracCycle() + compareAiracCycles() compute expiry. Check if cycle < currentCycle (outdated) or if currentCycle - cycle > 2 (severely outdated, >56 days). Also compute days-to-expiry for near-expiry warning (< 7 days).
problems.manualFix: Update navdata via Navigraph FMS Data Manager or other third-party provider. Launch the data manager, authenticate, select X-Plane 12 and install the latest AIRAC cycle to Custom Data/.

problems.title: Multiple navdata providers installed (potential conflict)
problems.symptom: Unpredictable FMS behavior if multiple cycle.json files exist in Custom Data/ subfolders (e.g., one from Navigraph, one from Aerosoft). X-Plane may load mixed data or prioritize incorrectly.
problems.detect: scan_navdata returns entries[]. If entries.length > 1, flag as potential conflict. List providerName for each entry to show user which providers are present.
problems.manualFix: Keep only one navdata provider. Delete or move unwanted provider folders from Custom Data/ (e.g., Custom Data/GNS430, Custom Data/navigraph_data). Restart X-Plane after removal.

problems.title: Custom Data folder does not exist
problems.symptom: Third-party navdata installers (Navigraph FMS Data Manager) fail silently or report installation errors. X-Plane falls back to default (likely outdated) navdata from Resources/default data/.
problems.detect: Check if {xplanePath}/Custom Data/ directory exists. scan_navdata command currently returns error if folder missing; wrap this to detect the specific missing-folder case.
problems.autoFix: fs.create_dir({xplanePath}/Custom Data)
problems.manualFix: Create the Custom Data folder manually at the root of your X-Plane 12 installation, then re-run navdata installers.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem check for Custom Data/ existence (scan_navdata already checks this)

problems.title: No third-party navdata installed (using default)
problems.symptom: FMS shows severely outdated procedures. Navdata cycle is static (ship date of X-Plane release, potentially 6-12+ months old). New airports, airways, or procedure changes not available.
problems.detect: scan_navdata returns entries[] empty (no cycle.json found in Custom Data/). Alternatively, check if Custom Data/ exists but contains no cycle.json files (WalkDir finds zero matches).
problems.manualFix: Install third-party navdata from Navigraph (requires subscription) or Aerosoft. Download Navigraph FMS Data Manager, authenticate, select X-Plane 12, and install current AIRAC cycle.

problems.title: Per-aircraft navdata cycle mismatch
problems.symptom: Study-level aircraft (Zibo 737, ToLiss, FlightFactor) show different AIRAC cycle on FMS compared to X-Plane base navdata. Leads to route/procedure discrepancies between aircraft FMS and ATC/map display.
problems.detect: NEW: scan_navdata currently only checks Custom Data/ root. Extend to also scan Aircraft/{aircraft_folder}/plugins/{fms_plugin}/navdata/ or similar per-aircraft paths (Zibo has Custom Data/ZIBO738/navdata, ToLiss has similar structure). Compare aircraft-specific cycle.json airac/cycle against base Custom Data cycle. Flag if mismatch.
problems.manualFix: Update per-aircraft navdata via Navigraph FMS Data Manager. In the data manager, expand the aircraft list (e.g., 'Zibo 737', 'ToLiss A321') and update each aircraft separately to match the base sim cycle.
problems.source: NEW: extended scan_navdata to cover per-aircraft navdata folders + cycle comparison logic

problems.title: Navdata backup available for restore
problems.symptom: Not a problem, but informational: user previously backed up navdata (e.g., before updating) and can restore if current install is corrupted or unwanted.
problems.detect: scan_navdata_backups returns non-empty array. Each backup has verification.cycle/airac and verification.backupTime. Show count and newest backup date.
problems.autoFix: restore_navdata_backup(xplanePath, backupFolderName)
problems.manualFix: Use XFast Manager's Management > Navdata tab to restore a previous backup, or manually copy files from Custom Data/Backup_Data/{backup_folder}/ back to Custom Data/.

problems.title: Navdata cycle.json malformed or unreadable
problems.symptom: scan_navdata finds cycle.json but cannot parse it (corrupt JSON, missing required fields). Navdata may not load correctly in X-Plane or cycle info is unknown.
problems.detect: NEW: scan_navdata currently silently skips unparseable cycle.json (returns None from parse_cycle_json). Instrument scan_navdata to track parse failures: if cycle.json exists but parse fails, log the path and report as malformed. Return diagnostic field in ManagementData.
problems.manualFix: Re-install navdata via FMS Data Manager to repair the cycle.json file. If the file persists as corrupt, manually delete the corrupted navdata folder and reinstall.
problems.source: NEW: instrumented scan_navdata to report parse failures

problems.title: Default navdata is outdated (no Custom Data override)
problems.symptom: Using X-Plane's built-in navdata which is frozen at the release date. If X-Plane 12 shipped with AIRAC 2213 (late 2022), data is 3+ years old by 2026. Procedures severely out of sync with real world.
problems.detect: Combination: no third-party navdata (entries.length === 0 from scan_navdata) AND X-Plane version/release date suggests old default cycle. NEW: optionally parse Resources/default data/earth_nav.dat or CIFP/ to extract default cycle number (first line comment may contain cycle info), compare to current.
problems.manualFix: Install third-party navdata (Navigraph or Aerosoft) to override the default data. The Custom Data folder has priority over Resources/default data/.
problems.source: scan_navdata (entries empty) + optional NEW: parse Resources/default data/ cycle info

problems.title: AIRAC cycle format invalid or unparseable
problems.symptom: cycle.json contains cycle/airac field but format is not YYCC (e.g., malformed string, missing digits). Cannot compute expiry or currency.
problems.detect: scan_navdata returns cycle/airac. Frontend airac.ts parseAiracCycle() returns null if format invalid (not 4 digits, cycle not 01-13). Flag entries where parseAiracCycle(cycle) === null.
problems.manualFix: Re-install navdata via official provider to correct the cycle format. If using custom/manual navdata, ensure cycle.json follows the YYCC format (e.g., '2605' for cycle 5 of 2026).
problems.source: scan_navdata (cycle/airac fields) + frontend airac.ts parseAiracCycle validation

problems.title: AIRAC cycle is from the future
problems.symptom: Navdata cycle is newer than current date should allow (e.g., 2607 when current is 2605). Possibly test data, incorrect system date, or pre-release cycle not yet effective.
problems.detect: scan_navdata returns cycle/airac. Frontend airac.ts getNavdataCycleStatus() returns 'future' if cycle > currentCycle. Flag for user review.
problems.manualFix: Verify your system date is correct. If intentionally using a future cycle (e.g., testing), ignore this warning. Otherwise, install the current AIRAC cycle via FMS Data Manager.

problems.title: CIFP folder missing or empty (procedures unavailable)
problems.symptom: Instrument approaches, SIDs, STARs not available in FMS. Aircraft can navigate direct-to but cannot load published procedures. FMS shows 'NO PROC' or similar errors.
problems.detect: NEW: Check if Custom Data/CIFP/ directory exists and contains .dat files (procedure files). If missing or empty, flag. Also check Resources/default data/CIFP/ as fallback. If both missing, critical.
problems.manualFix: Re-install navdata via Navigraph FMS Data Manager or other provider. CIFP folder should be populated with procedure files during navdata installation. Verify Custom Data/CIFP/ exists and contains files.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem check for Custom Data/CIFP/ and file count

problems.title: Core earth_*.dat files missing from Custom Data
problems.symptom: FMS and GPS do not load updated navaids, fixes, airways. Navdata appears installed (cycle.json present) but core data files are absent. X-Plane may fall back to default data or show navigation errors.
problems.detect: NEW: If cycle.json exists in Custom Data/, verify presence of critical files: earth_nav.dat, earth_fix.dat, earth_awy.dat in the same directory or Custom Data/ root. If cycle.json present but these files missing, flag as incomplete install.
problems.manualFix: Re-install navdata completely via FMS Data Manager. The installation may have been incomplete or corrupted. Delete the existing Custom Data navdata folder and reinstall from scratch.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem check for earth_nav.dat, earth_fix.dat, earth_awy.dat in Custom Data/

problems.title: Vulkan device error detected
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashes or shows 'Vulkan device lost' alerts. Graphics corruption, flickering, or sudden black screen followed by crash.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category='vulkan_device_error' (MACIBM_alert: Vulkan in Log.txt) OR crash_analysis -> crash_causes[] contains cause_key='gpu_driver_crash' with score >30%
problems.manualFix: 1. Update GPU driver: NVIDIA users need driver 510+ (visit nvidia.com/drivers), AMD users need Adrenaline 22.2.1+ (amd.com/support). 2. Verify GPU supports Vulkan 1.3 (use vulkan.gpuinfo.org or GPU-Z). 3. If using laptop with dual GPU, ensure X-Plane uses discrete GPU in Windows Graphics Settings. 4. If driver is current, roll back to previous stable version. 5. Check GPU temperature/stability with monitoring tool.

problems.title: NVIDIA GPU driver below minimum version
problems.symptom: X-Plane may fail to start, show Vulkan errors, or have rendering glitches. Performance issues or crashes after graphics settings changes.
problems.detect: NEW: analyze_xplane_log -> system_info.gpu_model contains 'NVIDIA' AND system_info.gpu_driver version < 510.0 (parse version string, handle formats like '510.47.0' or 'NVIDIA 510.47')
problems.manualFix: Update NVIDIA driver to version 510 or newer. Download from nvidia.com/drivers, select your GPU model, download Game Ready or Studio driver, run installer with 'Clean installation' checked. Restart after installation.
problems.source: NEW: parse system_info.gpu_driver from analyze_xplane_log, compare against X-Plane 12 minimum (510)

problems.title: AMD GPU driver below minimum version
problems.symptom: Vulkan initialization errors, poor performance, or crashes when loading scenery. Graphics artifacts or missing textures.
problems.detect: NEW: analyze_xplane_log -> system_info.gpu_model contains 'AMD' or 'Radeon' AND system_info.gpu_driver version < 22.2.1 (parse version string like 'Adrenalin 22.2.1' or date-based '2022.0201')
problems.manualFix: Update AMD driver to Adrenaline 22.2.1 or newer. Download from amd.com/support, select Radeon graphics, download Adrenalin software, run installer. Use 'Factory Reset' option if upgrading from very old driver. Restart after installation.
problems.source: NEW: parse system_info.gpu_driver from analyze_xplane_log, compare against X-Plane 12 minimum (Adrenaline 22.2.1)

problems.title: Unsupported Intel integrated GPU detected
problems.symptom: X-Plane fails to start with Vulkan errors, or runs with severe performance issues and visual corruption. May show 'No compatible Vulkan device' error.
problems.detect: NEW: analyze_xplane_log -> system_info.gpu_model contains 'Intel' AND NOT contains 'Arc' (X-Plane 12 only supports Intel Arc GPUs, not UHD/Iris/HD Graphics)
problems.manualFix: Intel integrated GPUs (UHD, Iris, HD Graphics) are NOT supported by X-Plane 12. Only Intel Arc discrete GPUs work. You need: (1) Desktop: install a dedicated NVIDIA (GTX 900+) or AMD (RX 500+) GPU. (2) Laptop: if you have dual GPU (Intel + NVIDIA/AMD), force X-Plane to use the discrete GPU in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics settings, add X-Plane.exe, set to 'High performance'. (3) Otherwise, X-Plane 12 cannot run on this hardware.
problems.source: NEW: analyze system_info.gpu_model from analyze_xplane_log against X-Plane 12 GPU compatibility (Intel Arc only)

problems.title: ReShade or GamePP injection blocked by X-Plane
problems.symptom: Visual enhancements from ReShade don't work. Log shows 'Disabled ReShade' or 'Disabled GamePP'. May cause startup delays or crashes if injector conflicts with Vulkan.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category='third_party_blocked' (I/GFX/VK: Disabled ReShade or GamePP in log) OR NEW: check if X-Plane folder contains ReShade.ini, reshade-shaders/, dxgi.dll, or d3d11.dll files
problems.manualFix: X-Plane 12 intentionally blocks ReShade, GamePP, and similar graphics injectors for Vulkan stability. Remove ReShade: delete ReShade.ini, dxgi.dll, d3d11.dll, reshade-shaders/ folder from X-Plane root. If you need better visuals, use native X-Plane settings (HDR, tone mapping) or community presets instead of injectors. Third-party injectors are incompatible with Vulkan renderer.
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log (third_party_blocked category), NEW: filesystem check for ReShade artifacts

problems.title: Third-party overlay software may cause crashes
problems.symptom: Random crashes during flight, especially when overlay activates. Stuttering, frame drops, or frozen screen. Crash may blame GPU driver or vulkan-1.dll.
problems.detect: analyze_crash_report -> loaded_modules[] contains module names matching: 'gameoverlayrenderer' (Steam), 'discordcanary' / 'discordptb' (Discord), 'rtss' / 'rtsshooks' (RivaTuner/MSI Afterburner), 'obs-vulkan' (OBS), 'fraps', 'shadowplay', 'GeForceNOW', 'nvidia share', OR crash_causes[] contains 'dll_conflict' with blamed_module containing these names
problems.manualFix: Disable overlays before running X-Plane: (1) Steam: Settings > In-Game > uncheck 'Enable Steam Overlay'. (2) Discord: User Settings > Game Overlay > disable. (3) MSI Afterburner/RivaTuner: close app or disable 'On-Screen Display support'. (4) NVIDIA GeForce Experience: Alt+Z > Settings > In-Game Overlay > disable. (5) Windows Game Bar: Settings > Gaming > Xbox Game Bar > disable. Overlays inject code into Vulkan and can cause device-lost crashes.
problems.source: analyze_crash_report (loaded_modules[], dll_conflict cause with is_injected_dll matches)

problems.title: NVIDIA API permission denied
problems.symptom: Performance monitoring broken, G-Sync may not work, or advanced NVIDIA features disabled. Usually doesn't crash but logged as medium severity.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category='nvidia_permission' (E/NVAPI or NVAPI_INVALID_USER_PRIVILEGE in log)
problems.manualFix: Run X-Plane as Administrator once to grant NVIDIA API permissions (right-click X-Plane.exe > Run as administrator). If issue persists: (1) Update NVIDIA driver. (2) Repair NVIDIA driver: Device Manager > Display adapters > right-click GPU > Uninstall (keep driver) > Scan for hardware changes. (3) Reinstall NVIDIA driver with 'Clean installation' option. This error usually doesn't prevent flying but may affect G-Sync or performance overlays.

problems.title: Vulkan runtime not found or corrupted
problems.symptom: X-Plane fails to start with 'Vulkan device not found' or 'vulkan-1.dll missing'. May show Windows error dialog before log is written.
problems.detect: NEW: check if vulkan-1.dll exists in System32 (C:\Windows\System32\vulkan-1.dll on Windows), OR analyze_xplane_log shows vulkan_device_error but system_info.gpu_model is empty (GPU present but Vulkan not detecting it)
problems.manualFix: (1) Update GPU driver — this installs Vulkan runtime automatically (NVIDIA 510+, AMD Adrenaline 22.2.1+). (2) If driver is current, manually install Vulkan SDK from lunarg.com/vulkan-sdk (download runtime installer only, not full SDK). (3) Verify GPU supports Vulkan 1.3 at vulkan.gpuinfo.org. (4) On laptops, ensure discrete GPU is active (not Intel integrated). (5) Restart after driver/runtime install.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem check for vulkan-1.dll, cross-reference with analyze_xplane_log vulkan errors

problems.title: GPU VRAM below recommended 8GB
problems.symptom: Severe texture downscaling (log shows 'Target scale moved to 0.0625'), stuttering when loading new scenery, crashes with out_of_memory when flying over detailed areas.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category='severe_texture_downscale' OR 'heavy_memory_pressure' OR 'out_of_memory', AND NEW: check GPU VRAM size from system_info.gpu_model (lookup table or WMI query) < 8GB, OR crash_analysis -> crash_causes[] contains 'memory_exhaustion' + vulkan_device_error in log
problems.manualFix: Your GPU has less than the recommended 8GB VRAM for X-Plane 12. Reduce VRAM usage: (1) Graphics Settings > Texture Quality: High → Medium or Low. (2) Lower 'Objects' and 'Number of World Objects' sliders. (3) Reduce 'Reflection Detail'. (4) Disable 'Sparse Scenery Tiles' (uses more VRAM for seamless loading). (5) Fly over less dense scenery initially. (6) Close other GPU-heavy apps. For permanent fix, upgrade to GPU with 8GB+ VRAM (RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT or better).
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log (severe_texture_downscale, heavy_memory_pressure, out_of_memory), NEW: VRAM detection from gpu_model or OS query

problems.title: HDR configuration may cause rendering issues
problems.symptom: Washed-out colors, overly bright or dark scenes, incorrect tone mapping, or crashes when toggling HDR. Issues appear only on HDR-capable monitors with Windows HDR enabled.
problems.detect: NEW: check if Windows HDR is enabled (registry HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM\AdvancedColorEnabled = 1 on Windows 10/11) AND analyze_xplane_log contains graphics errors (gfx_error, vulkan_gfx_error) OR severe rendering issues reported in log tail
problems.manualFix: X-Plane 12 HDR support is evolving and may have compatibility issues with certain monitor/driver combinations. If you experience rendering problems: (1) Toggle Windows HDR: Settings > System > Display > Use HDR > Off, restart X-Plane. (2) Update GPU driver (HDR fixes in recent versions). (3) In X-Plane Graphics settings, adjust 'Tone Mapping' curve if colors are wrong. (4) Some monitors need specific driver settings — check monitor manufacturer forums. (5) If crashes persist, disable HDR in Windows until X-Plane/driver update fixes it.
problems.source: NEW: Windows registry/API HDR detection, cross-reference with analyze_xplane_log gfx errors

problems.title: Multi-monitor or mixed refresh rate issues
problems.symptom: Stuttering, frame timing inconsistency, screen tearing, or crashes when X-Plane spans multiple monitors or runs on secondary monitor with different refresh rate. May see 'Runloop is backed up' warnings.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log -> issues[] contains category='runloop_backlog' (W/RLP: Runloop is backed up) AND NEW: detect multiple monitors with different refresh rates (WMI query EnumerationMode or registry display settings) OR crashes with swapchain/present errors in vulkan_gfx_error
problems.manualFix: Multi-monitor and mixed refresh rates can cause timing issues: (1) Run X-Plane on your highest refresh rate monitor. (2) Set all monitors to same refresh rate if possible (Windows Display settings). (3) Disable G-Sync/FreeSync if using multiple monitors (NVIDIA Control Panel or AMD Adrenalin). (4) Use windowed mode instead of fullscreen if spanning monitors. (5) Close GPU-heavy apps on secondary monitors (videos, browsers with hardware acceleration). (6) Update GPU driver — recent versions improved multi-monitor Vulkan support.
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log (runloop_backlog category), NEW: multi-monitor detection from OS API

problems.title: xOrganizer detected (scenery manager conflict)
problems.symptom: Scenery loading order unpredictable, scenery_packs.ini overwritten by multiple tools, potential conflicts if both XFast Manager and xOrganizer try to manage scenery simultaneously.
problems.detect: NEW: check if xOrganizer is installed — scan X-Plane folder for 'xOrganizer/' or 'xOrganizer.exe', or check scenery_packs.ini for comment line containing 'xOrganizer' signature
problems.manualFix: xOrganizer is another scenery manager tool. Using multiple scenery managers can cause conflicts: (1) Choose one tool (XFast Manager or xOrganizer) and disable the other. (2) If using XFast Manager, close xOrganizer and let XFast manage scenery_packs.ini. (3) If using xOrganizer, disable XFast's automatic scenery sorting. (4) Never run both tools simultaneously. (5) After choosing, use XFast's 'Sort Scenery Packs' to rebuild proper load order. Both tools are safe individually, but simultaneous use causes unpredictable behavior.
problems.source: NEW: filesystem scan for xOrganizer installation or signature in scenery_packs.ini

problems.title: Duplicate plugin detected
problems.symptom: X-Plane logs 'a version of this plugin is already loaded' warnings. Plugins may conflict, cause crashes, or fail to load entirely. Common with FlyWithLua, AviTab, or BetterPushback installed twice in different locations.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='duplicate_plugin'. Cross-reference with scan_plugins to identify which plugin folders contain duplicate signatures.
problems.manualFix: Open Resources/plugins folder. Identify duplicate plugin folders (check Log.txt sample_line for plugin name). Keep only one copy—usually the newest or the one from the official source. Delete or disable the duplicate via XFast Manager's plugin management UI.

problems.title: Plugin failed to load
problems.symptom: Expected plugin features not working. Log shows E/PLG errors like 'error', 'fail', or 'crash'. May be due to missing dependencies, wrong SDK version (XPLM 2.x vs 3.x vs 4.x), 32-bit plugin on 64-bit X-Plane, or corrupted files.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='plugin_error' (severity: high). Parse sample_line for plugin name and error details.
problems.manualFix: Check Log.txt sample_line for the failing plugin name and error message. Common fixes: (1) Update plugin to latest version (check XFast Manager Updates page). (2) If 'wrong SDK' or 'XPLM version': plugin needs recompile for XP12. (3) If 'missing DLL/dylib': reinstall plugin or install Visual C++ Redistributables (Windows). (4) If beta XP12 build: check plugin compatibility with that specific beta.

problems.title: Plugin assertion failed
problems.symptom: X-Plane logs 'E/PLG: Plugin assert:' indicating a plugin-internal check failed. May cause instability or crashes. Often triggered by bad state, API misuse, or incompatibility with X-Plane beta changes.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='plugin_assert' (severity: high). Extract plugin name from sample_line.
problems.manualFix: Identify the failing plugin from Log.txt sample_line. (1) Check if plugin has an update (XFast Manager Updates page or plugin author's site). (2) If on XP12 beta: plugin may be incompatible with this beta build—check X-Plane.org plugin page for beta compatibility notes. (3) Disable the plugin temporarily (XFast Manager Plugins page) to test stability. (4) Report issue to plugin developer with full Log.txt.

problems.title: Missing plugin support file
problems.symptom: Plugin installed but not functioning. Log shows 'you are missing a required plugin support file'. Common with complex plugins requiring additional DLLs, libraries, or Resources files.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='missing_plugin_support' (severity: high).
problems.manualFix: Reinstall the plugin completely using the full installer or archive from the official source (not partial update). Ensure all files from the archive are extracted—incomplete extraction is a common cause. For Windows plugins: install Visual C++ Redistributables 2015-2022 (x64). For complex plugins (XPUIPC, FSUIPC-bridge): check documentation for prerequisite libraries.

problems.title: ReShade or GamePP blocked by X-Plane
problems.symptom: Log shows 'I/GFX/VK: Disabled ReShade' or 'Disabled GamePP'. Vulkan injectors cause instability and crashes in X-Plane 12. Laminar Research blocks them on startup for safety.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='third_party_blocked' (severity: medium). Check for ReShade.ini, reshade-shaders/, or GamePP DLLs in X-Plane root or vulkan-1.dll wrapper.
problems.manualFix: Remove ReShade/GamePP completely: (1) Delete ReShade.ini, reshade-shaders/, dxgi.dll, d3d11.dll, vulkan-1.dll from X-Plane root if they're NOT original X-Plane files. (2) Run ReShade uninstaller if installed. (3) For visual enhancement, use X-Plane's native color grading (Settings > Graphics > HDR). ReShade is incompatible with Vulkan flight sims and WILL cause crashes.
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log (category: third_party_blocked); NEW: check for ReShade.ini, reshade-shaders/ in xplanePath

problems.title: Plugin updates available
problems.symptom: Using outdated plugin versions. Newer versions may fix crashes, improve performance, or add XP12 compatibility. Especially critical for beta X-Plane builds where API changes frequently.
problems.detect: scan_plugins + check_plugins_updates returns entries with has_update=true. Count outdated plugins.
problems.autoFix: User clicks 'Update All Plugins' on Doctor page → batch update via existing update flow (SkunkCrafts/X-Updater providers)
problems.manualFix: Go to XFast Manager Updates page. Review available plugin updates. Update one-by-one or use batch update. After updating, test in X-Plane to ensure compatibility.

problems.title: Missing platform-specific plugin binary
problems.symptom: Plugin shows as installed but features don't work. Common when installing a plugin built only for macOS on Windows, or vice versa. Log may show 'plugin not loaded' or silent failure.
problems.detect: NEW: scan_plugins returns platform field. Cross-check current OS (get_platform) with detected platform. Flag if plugin has no .xpl for current platform (e.g., platform='mac' but running on Windows).
problems.manualFix: Check plugin's X-Plane.org or official page for a cross-platform version or platform-specific download. Re-download the correct build for your OS. Some plugins (e.g., old freeware) only support one platform—in that case, find an alternative plugin with similar functionality.

problems.title: X-Plane plugin manager internal error
problems.symptom: X-Plane's plugin system itself is malfunctioning. Log shows 'plugin manager internal error'. No plugins load, or X-Plane becomes unstable. Rare but critical—indicates corrupted X-Plane installation or severe plugin conflict.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='plugin_manager_error' (severity: high).
problems.manualFix: (1) Move all plugins out of Resources/plugins (to a backup folder). Restart X-Plane—if it loads, gradually re-add plugins one-by-one to isolate the conflict. (2) If still failing: verify X-Plane installation via Steam/Laminar installer, or reinstall X-Plane. (3) Check X-Plane.org forums for known plugin manager bugs in your XP12 beta/release version.

problems.title: Beta X-Plane build may break plugins
problems.symptom: Running an X-Plane 12 beta/release-candidate build. Plugin API (XPLM) changes between betas can break plugins until authors update. Common with early betas or major version changes.
problems.detect: NEW: extract X-Plane version from system_info.xplane_version. Flag if version string contains 'b' (beta) or 'rc' (release candidate) AND (plugin_error OR plugin_assert issues exist OR crash_detected=true with plugin_crash cause).
problems.manualFix: Beta builds are for testing and may have plugin compatibility issues. (1) Check each plugin's X-Plane.org page for 'beta compatibility' notes. (2) Disable plugins with known issues (XFast Manager Plugins page). (3) Report plugin crashes to plugin authors with your beta build number. (4) Consider switching to the stable X-Plane release channel if plugins are essential to your workflow.
problems.source: NEW: analyze_xplane_log (system_info.xplane_version regex) + existing issue categories

problems.title: FlyWithLua scripts disabled
problems.symptom: FlyWithLua plugin installed but specific Lua scripts (.xfml files) are disabled and not running. Features from those scripts (custom commands, UI elements, automation) are missing.
problems.detect: NEW: scan_plugins shows FlyWithLua (folder_name contains 'flywithlua' case-insensitive) with has_scripts=true but script_count includes disabled .xfml files. Need separate query to list disabled scripts.
problems.autoFix: Enable all disabled FlyWithLua scripts (rename .xfml → .lua) via XFast Manager Scripts UI
problems.manualFix: Go to XFast Manager Scripts page (FlyWithLua section). Review disabled scripts (marked with .xfml extension). Enable desired scripts by clicking toggle. Restart X-Plane to apply changes.
problems.source: NEW: scan_plugins (has_scripts, script_count) + query disabled scripts in FlyWithLua/Scripts/

problems.title: Plugin using deprecated datarefs
problems.symptom: Log shows 'Dataref X has been replaced' warnings. Plugin relies on old X-Plane API datarefs that may be removed in future versions. Functionality may break or behave unexpectedly.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] with category='deprecated_dataref' (severity: low). Extract dataref name from sample_line.
problems.manualFix: Note which plugin is accessing the deprecated dataref (check preceding lines in Log.txt for plugin name). (1) Check if plugin has an update—authors often fix deprecated API usage in updates. (2) If no update available: notify plugin developer via X-Plane.org or GitHub. (3) Plugin will likely continue working but may break in future X-Plane versions.

problems.title: Crash caused by plugin
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashed and minidump analysis blames a specific plugin. The crash stack trace points to a .xpl file. Plugin may have bugs, memory leaks, or incompatibility with X-Plane version or other plugins.
problems.detect: analyze_crash_report returns crash_causes[] with cause_key='plugin_crash' and high score (>0.6), plus blamed_module is a .xpl file. Cross-reference with scan_plugins to get plugin folder name.
problems.manualFix: Identify the crashing plugin from crash report (blamed_module). (1) Disable the plugin temporarily (XFast Manager Plugins page) to confirm it's the cause. (2) Check for plugin updates. (3) Report crash to plugin developer with .dmp file (Output/crash_reports/reports/) and Log.txt. (4) If plugin is abandoned/unmaintained, uninstall and find an alternative.

problems.title: Severe texture downscaling detected
problems.symptom: Textures appear blurry or low-quality during flight; X-Plane has automatically reduced texture resolution to 0.0625x (1/16th scale) due to VRAM pressure, causing noticeable visual degradation and potential stuttering as the downscale occurs.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='severe_texture_downscale' (Log.txt line: 'I/TEX: Target scale moved to 0.0625'). This indicates X-Plane exhausted available VRAM and applied maximum texture reduction.
problems.manualFix: Reduce texture quality in Graphics settings (Textures: High instead of Maximum saves 1-2GB VRAM). Lower anti-aliasing (disable SSAA if enabled, use MSAA 2x instead). Reduce reflection detail, world object density, or visual effects. Consider removing high-resolution livery/scenery addons or upgrading GPU. Check GPU temperature and ensure drivers are current.

problems.title: Frame timing backlog detected
problems.symptom: Stuttering, frame drops, or sluggish controls; X-Plane's main loop is falling behind, unable to process frames at the target rate, resulting in laggy or unresponsive flight experience.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='runloop_backlog' (Log.txt line: 'W/RLP: Runloop is backed up'). Indicates CPU or main-thread bottleneck.
problems.manualFix: Reduce CPU-intensive settings: lower number of world objects, AI aircraft count, and weather effects. Disable or remove poorly-optimized plugins (check Log.txt for slow plugin messages). Close background applications. If the issue is persistent, reduce scenery complexity or use simpler aircraft. Check for plugin updates that improve performance.

problems.title: Heavy memory pressure state
problems.symptom: System RAM is critically low; X-Plane entered heavy memory pressure, leading to severe performance degradation, potential paging to disk (extreme stuttering), or imminent out-of-memory crash.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='heavy_memory_pressure' (Log.txt lines: 'W/MEM: Entered heavy memory pressure state' or 'E/MEM: Physical memory usage'). Severity=high.
problems.manualFix: Close all non-essential background applications and browser tabs. Reduce X-Plane settings: lower texture quality, reduce number of world objects, decrease AI aircraft, lower cloud puffs count. Disable memory-heavy plugins or scenery. Increase Windows page file size (set to system-managed or manually set 1.5-3x RAM size). Consider upgrading system RAM (X-Plane 12 benefits from 32GB+). Restart X-Plane to clear accumulated memory usage.

problems.title: Out of memory error
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashes to desktop or becomes unresponsive; memory allocation failed, causing immediate crash or freeze. This is the terminal state after prolonged memory pressure.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='out_of_memory' (Log.txt contains 'out of memory', 'memory allocation failed', 'cannot allocate', Chinese equivalents, or 'E/SYS: THREAD FATAL ASSERT' with memory keywords). Severity=high.
problems.manualFix: Same as heavy memory pressure, but more urgent. Ensure Windows page file is enabled and system-managed (minimum 16GB for X-Plane 12). Remove or reduce high-VRAM addons (orthophoto scenery, 8K liveries, complex aircraft). If crash is reproducible at specific airports, the scenery may be too complex—try a different airport or remove custom scenery for that region. Check for memory leaks in plugins (disable plugins one by one to isolate). Upgrade RAM if system has less than 32GB.

problems.title: Crash caused by memory exhaustion
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashed to desktop; minidump analysis indicates the crash was caused by running out of RAM or VRAM, rather than a plugin or driver bug.
problems.detect: analyze_crash_report returns crash_causes[] containing cause_key='memory_exhaustion' with high score. Cross-reference with analyze_xplane_log showing heavy_memory_pressure or out_of_memory before the crash.
problems.manualFix: Follow out-of-memory fixes. The crash dump confirms memory was the root cause. Prioritize: increase page file, reduce texture quality and world objects, disable heavy scenery, check for plugin memory leaks. Consider clean reinstall of X-Plane if memory usage is abnormally high with default scenery and no addons.

problems.title: Regular memory pressure state
problems.symptom: X-Plane is approaching RAM limits; while not critical, the simulator is using more memory than comfortable, and performance may degrade during high-load scenarios (complex airports, weather transitions, long flights).
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='regular_memory_pressure' (Log.txt line: 'I/MEM: Entered regular memory pressure state'). Severity=low.
problems.manualFix: Monitor performance during flight. If no issues occur, no action needed—X-Plane is managing memory actively. If stuttering develops, reduce texture quality slightly, lower number of world objects, or reduce cloud detail. Close background applications before long flights. This is a proactive warning, not an immediate problem.

problems.title: SSAA anti-aliasing may be too demanding
problems.symptom: Low FPS (10-30 fps) despite powerful GPU; SSAA (Super Sampling Anti-Aliasing) renders the scene at 2x or 4x resolution then downscales, consuming massive GPU resources. SSAA 2x = 4x pixel count, SSAA 4x = 16x pixel count. Most users see 30-60 FPS gains by disabling SSAA.
problems.detect: NEW: Parse Output/preferences/X-Plane.prf, extract line containing 'sim/graphics/settings/SSAA', check if value is 1 (2x) or 2 (4x). If enabled AND analyze_xplane_log shows no crash but runloop_backlog or severe_texture_downscale present, flag this.
problems.autoFix: NEW: set_xplane_preference(xplanePath, 'sim/graphics/settings/SSAA', '0') — safely edit X-Plane.prf while X-Plane is NOT running (guarded by is_xplane_running check). Backup .prf before modification.
problems.manualFix: Open X-Plane Graphics settings, set Anti-aliasing to MSAA 2x or 4x instead of SSAA. Or manually edit Output/preferences/X-Plane.prf (while X-Plane is closed): find line starting with 'sim/graphics/settings/SSAA' and change value to 0. Save and restart X-Plane. Expect significant FPS improvement.

problems.title: Maximum texture quality with limited VRAM
problems.symptom: Frequent texture downscaling, stuttering, or VRAM pressure warnings; texture quality is set to Maximum but GPU has 8GB VRAM or less, causing constant memory thrashing as X-Plane tries to load high-res textures that don't fit.
problems.detect: NEW: Parse X-Plane.prf for 'sim/graphics/settings/texture_quality' = 3 (Maximum) AND analyze_xplane_log system_info.gpu_model VRAM estimation (if gpu_model contains 'RTX 3060' / '3070' / '4060' / 'RX 6700' or similar <=8GB cards) OR if severe_texture_downscale issue is present.
problems.autoFix: NEW: set_xplane_preference(xplanePath, 'sim/graphics/settings/texture_quality', '2') — reduce to High (value 2). Requires X-Plane not running.
problems.manualFix: Open X-Plane Graphics settings and change Texture Quality from Maximum to High. This typically saves 1-2GB VRAM with minimal visual difference at normal viewing distances. Or edit X-Plane.prf: set 'sim/graphics/settings/texture_quality' to 2. Restart X-Plane.

problems.title: Shader cache may be corrupted
problems.symptom: First flight after launch has severe stuttering every few seconds, or graphics artifacts appear; corrupted shader cache forces X-Plane to recompile shaders during flight instead of loading from cache, causing frame hitches.
problems.detect: NEW: Check if Output/shadercache/ folder exists and is non-empty, AND analyze_xplane_log contains gfx_error or vulkan_gfx_error issues, OR scan_output_cleanup_items returns shadercache size > 500MB (abnormally large, indicating possible corruption/bloat).
problems.autoFix: clean_output_items(xplanePath, ['shadercache']) — delete and regenerate. X-Plane will rebuild cache on next launch (first flight will have one-time compilation stutter, then smooth). Safe operation.
problems.manualFix: Close X-Plane. Delete the folder: X-Plane 12/Output/shadercache/. Restart X-Plane. The first flight will have brief stutter as shaders compile, but subsequent flights will be smooth. This is a common fix for graphics glitches after GPU driver updates.

problems.title: Old crash dumps accumulating
problems.symptom: Disk space wasted; old crash dumps (.dmp files) from past crashes remain in CrashReporter/ folder, serving no purpose once analyzed. Each dump can be 30-100MB.
problems.detect: NEW: Scan X-Plane path / CrashReporter/ folder for .dmp files older than 30 days, or if analyze_crash_report was already run and skipDateCheck=true (meaning crash is older than current log), flag those .dmp files. Count files and total size.
problems.manualFix: Navigate to X-Plane 12/CrashReporter/ and manually delete old .dmp files that you no longer need for analysis. Keep the most recent one if you plan to report a bug. Deleting .dmp files is safe and does not affect X-Plane functionality.
problems.source: NEW: scan CrashReporter/ folder by modification time

problems.title: Negative memory pressure state detected
problems.symptom: X-Plane memory usage has returned to safe levels after a previous pressure state; this is an informational message indicating recovery, not a problem. However, frequent cycling between pressure states suggests system is borderline for current settings.
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log returns issues[] containing category='negative_memory_pressure' (Log.txt line: 'I/MEM: Entered negative memory pressure state'). Severity=medium. If this appears multiple times in same log, flag as oscillating memory state.
problems.manualFix: No immediate action required—memory pressure resolved. If you see repeated cycles of regular→heavy→negative pressure in logs, your system is at the edge of stability. Consider reducing settings slightly to avoid future crashes: lower texture quality one notch, reduce number of world objects by 10-20%, or add more RAM.

problems.title: Large Output caches can be cleaned
problems.symptom: Disk space consumed by temporary caches; X-Plane's Output folder accumulates caches (shadercache, ATC voices, terrain cache) that can grow to several GB. These are safe to delete and will regenerate as needed. If caches exceed 500MB, cleanup saves noticeable disk space.
problems.detect: scan_output_cleanup_items returns total cleanable size > 200MB. Categories include shadercache, caches, logs (old Log.txt backups).
problems.autoFix: clean_output_items(xplanePath, cleanableCategories) — delete selected cache categories. Safe operation, X-Plane regenerates on demand. Block if is_xplane_running=true.
problems.manualFix: Use XFast Manager's built-in cleanup tool or manually delete: X-Plane 12/Output/caches/, Output/shadercache/ (if shader cache problem), old Output/Log.txt.* backup files. Do not delete the current Log.txt. Restart X-Plane after cleaning; caches will regenerate.

problems.title: X-Plane executable missing or corrupted
problems.symptom: X-Plane fails to launch, installer cannot find the executable, or the file is damaged
problems.detect: validate_xplane_path returns false — existing command checks for presence of X-Plane executable (X-Plane.exe, X-Plane-x86_64, or versioned variants) in the root directory
problems.manualFix: Reinstall X-Plane from the official installer (Laminar Research for standalone, Steam for Steam version). If Steam: right-click X-Plane 12 in library → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files. If standalone: download installer from x-plane.com and run Update on existing install to repair missing files.

problems.title: Beta build with mixed file versions
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashes on launch after beta update, or shows version mismatch errors in Log.txt
problems.detect: NEW: system_info.xplane_version from analyze_xplane_log contains '-b' suffix (beta indicator like '12.4.3-b4') AND crash_detected=true from same analysis, or log issues contain 'version_mismatch' category
problems.manualFix: Beta builds can have incomplete downloads. Re-run the X-Plane installer: launch X-Plane.app/X-Plane.exe, open Settings → About → Check for Updates. If the updater is stuck or fails, download the full installer from x-plane.com and run Update (not Install) on your existing directory to repair all files.

problems.title: Low disk space may cause install failures
problems.symptom: Addon installs fail mid-process, or X-Plane updates abort with 'insufficient space' errors
problems.detect: NEW: use fs2 crate (already in Cargo.toml) to query available_space() on the X-Plane drive. Trigger if free space < 5GB. fs2::statvfs (Unix) or fs2::available_space (cross-platform) on the X-Plane root path.
problems.manualFix: Free up disk space on the X-Plane drive. Use XFast Manager's Output cleanup to remove shader caches and logs (typically 200-500MB). Delete unneeded aircraft/scenery, or move X-Plane to a larger drive. X-Plane requires ~5GB free for safe addon installs and shader cache generation.

problems.title: Read-only files blocking installs or updates
problems.symptom: Addon installs fail with 'permission denied' or 'access denied' errors; X-Plane updater cannot overwrite files
problems.detect: NEW: scan key X-Plane directories (Aircraft, Resources/plugins, Custom Scenery) for files with read-only attribute set (permissions.readonly() on Windows, mode & 0o200 == 0 on Unix). Report if >10 files are read-only in addon directories.
problems.autoFix: NEW: recursively clear read-only attribute on X-Plane root (reuse clear_readonly_recursive logic from atomic_installer.rs, already handles both Windows and Unix). Present confirmation dialog: 'Clear read-only attributes from X-Plane directory? This will allow installs and updates to proceed.'
problems.manualFix: Clear read-only attributes manually: On Windows, right-click X-Plane folder → Properties → uncheck 'Read-only' → Apply to all subfolders. On macOS/Linux: chmod -R u+w /path/to/X-Plane. This often happens when copying X-Plane from read-only media (DVD, network share) or after certain installers.
problems.source: NEW: scan directories + reuse clear_readonly_recursive from atomic_installer.rs

problems.title: Antivirus interference detected
problems.symptom: Addon installs fail with 'file locked' or 'access denied'; .xpl/.dll files disappear after install; XFast Manager hangs during extraction
problems.detect: NEW: atomic installer failures (install_addons errors) with ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION (Windows error 32) or ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (error 5) in the error string, occurring repeatedly (>2 failures in activity log within 1 hour). Or: check activity log for failed installs with 'permission' or 'access' in error messages.
problems.manualFix: Add X-Plane directory to antivirus exclusions: Windows Defender → Settings → Virus & threat protection → Exclusions → Add folder → select X-Plane root. Third-party AV (Avast, Norton, McAfee): consult their docs to exclude the X-Plane folder. Antivirus often blocks .xpl/.dll files thinking they are malware.
problems.source: NEW: scan activity log (get_activity_log) for recent failures with permission/access errors

problems.title: Steam overlay causing crashes (Steam version only)
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashes on launch or during flight; crash dump shows gameoverlayrenderer.dll or steam_api64.dll in the stack
problems.detect: analyze_crash_report → crash_causes contains 'dll_conflict' with blamed_module containing 'steam' or 'gameoverlayrenderer'. Or: loaded_plugins list in crash analysis includes steam_api.
problems.manualFix: Disable Steam overlay for X-Plane: In Steam library, right-click X-Plane 12 → Properties → uncheck 'Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game'. The Steam overlay injects DLLs into X-Plane's Vulkan/OpenGL context, causing GPU driver conflicts. If crashes persist, launch X-Plane.exe directly from the install folder (bypassing Steam).

problems.title: Incomplete addon install detected
problems.symptom: Addon appears partially installed; files missing; X-Plane shows 'missing dependency' errors for a recently installed addon
problems.detect: NEW: activity log (get_activity_log) shows install_addons action with status='failed' or result containing 'rolled back' within the last 7 days. Indicates the atomic installer aborted mid-install and attempted rollback.
problems.manualFix: Re-install the addon using XFast Manager. The atomic installer rolled back a failed install, but some files may remain. Check the activity log for the specific error (low disk space, permission denied, antivirus block). Address the root cause, then retry installation.

problems.title: X-Plane is running (installs will fail)
problems.symptom: Addon installs or updates fail with 'file in use' or 'access denied' errors; scenery_packs.ini cannot be written
problems.detect: is_xplane_running returns true
problems.manualFix: Close X-Plane completely before installing addons or making changes. XFast Manager cannot modify X-Plane files while the simulator is running (file locks prevent writes). Save your flight, quit X-Plane, then retry the install.

problems.title: X-Plane installed in Program Files (UAC restrictions)
problems.symptom: Addon installs fail with permission errors; settings don't save; X-Plane asks for admin rights on every launch
problems.detect: NEW: X-Plane path (from validate_xplane_path) contains 'Program Files' or 'Program Files (x86)' (case-insensitive). Windows UAC restricts write access to these directories, causing install failures even when user is admin.
problems.manualFix: Move X-Plane out of Program Files. Laminar Research explicitly recommends installing X-Plane to a user-writable location (e.g., C:\X-Plane 12 or D:\X-Plane 12). Use the official installer to reinstall to a new location, then copy your Custom Scenery/Aircraft folders manually. Do NOT run XFast Manager or X-Plane as administrator — fix the root cause by moving the install.
problems.source: NEW: path string analysis on validated X-Plane path

problems.title: Corrupted scenery_packs.ini file
problems.symptom: X-Plane shows no custom scenery; all airports revert to default; scenery manager fails to load
problems.detect: get_scenery_manager_data fails with parse error, or returns needs_sync=true with entries.length=0 (indicating scenery_packs.ini exists but is empty/corrupt)
problems.autoFix: sort_scenery_packs(xplanePath, []) — regenerates scenery_packs.ini by scanning Custom Scenery and writing correct load order. Safe operation (no data loss, just rewrites the index file).
problems.manualFix: Use XFast Manager's scenery manager to regenerate scenery_packs.ini (click 'Re-sort Scenery'). Or manually: delete Custom Scenery/scenery_packs.ini, launch X-Plane, and it will rebuild the file on startup (scenery will appear in default order, requiring re-sort).

problems.title: Missing core X-Plane resource directories
problems.symptom: X-Plane fails to launch with 'missing Resources folder' or similar error; plugins/aircraft don't load
problems.detect: NEW: after validate_xplane_path succeeds, check for existence of critical directories: Resources/, Resources/plugins/, Aircraft/, Custom Scenery/. If any are missing, flag as critical integrity failure.
problems.manualFix: Critical X-Plane directories are missing. Reinstall X-Plane: if Steam version, use 'Verify integrity of game files' in Steam. If standalone, download the installer from x-plane.com and run a full install (do not use Update mode). This usually indicates a corrupted or incomplete installation.
problems.source: NEW: directory existence checks after validate_xplane_path

problems.title: Third-party graphics injectors detected (ReShade/ENB)
problems.symptom: X-Plane crashes on launch or has visual glitches; GPU driver errors in Log.txt; crashes after graphics settings change
problems.detect: analyze_xplane_log → issues array contains category='third_party_blocked' with sample_line mentioning ReShade or other injectors. Or: NEW: check for ReShade.ini, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll, opengl32.dll in X-Plane root (these are ReShade/ENB injection DLLs).
problems.manualFix: Remove ReShade/ENB: delete ReShade.ini, reshade-shaders/, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll, opengl32.dll from X-Plane root. These graphics injectors intercept Vulkan/OpenGL calls and frequently cause crashes or GPU driver conflicts. X-Plane 12 has built-in post-processing; third-party injectors are not needed and actively harm stability.
problems.source: analyze_xplane_log (issues category='third_party_blocked') + NEW: file existence checks
