Detection canonical (has_update=true from check_*_updates). Tier 'confirm' overstated—just navigates to UI, doesn't apply updates. Should be 'none' (info only).
Detection sound (scan for both skunkcrafts_updater.cfg + X-Updater profile). Code confirms enforce_obfuscated_xupdater_lock logic. Medium confidence appropriate.
Detection requires get_addon_updater_credentials command not visible in codebase. If command exists, logic is sound. Confidence should be 'low' until verified.
Detection sound (gpu_model contains 'Intel' AND NOT 'Arc'). Logic correct per X-Plane 12 requirements. Manual fix accurate. High confidence warranted.

Detection weak—VRAM size lookup from gpu_model string or WMI is unreliable/unimplemented. Should trigger only on severe_texture_downscale + out_of_memory log patterns, not speculative VRAM checks. Confidence should be 'low'.

Detection is solid (crash + vulkan error + shadercache exists). Fix is safe (X-Plane regenerates). Tier should be 'safe' not 'confirm' — this is a standard troubleshooting step with no data loss risk.
Detection via needs_sync is correct (backend computes this). sort_scenery_packs with empty locked array is safe — backend has robust sort logic. Tier 'safe' is accurate.

Detection is FALSE POSITIVE prone. Proposal compares Mesh sort_order to GLOBAL_AIRPORTS but doesn't account for enabled state or that Global Airports can be repositioned. Also, ortho IS mesh, so this duplicates wrong_load_order. Redundant check with flawed logic.

Detection is INCORRECT. scan_navdata returns ONE active navdata install (cycle.json), not multiple providers. X-Plane 12 uses a single cycle.json. Multiple entries would only appear if user manually created duplicate Custom Data substructures, which is rare. Low signal.

Detection requires NEW backend instrumentation that doesn't exist. scan_navdata silently skips parse failures (returns empty, not error). This check is speculative until backend is modified. Valid idea but not implementable without code changes.

Detection is sound (analyze_xplane_log category='third_party_blocked' exists). Fix is NOT auto-fixable (requires manual file deletion + understanding which DLLs are safe to delete). Correctly marked as not auto-fixable.

Detection requires NEW backend query that doesn't exist. scan_plugins doesn't return disabled script counts. Also, enabling all scripts blindly is NOT safe (users disable scripts for a reason — conflicts, performance). Flawed premise.

Detection requires NEW X-Plane.prf parser + VRAM estimation heuristics (both missing). VRAM can't be reliably estimated from GPU model string (3060 has 8GB and 12GB variants). Also, set_xplane_preference command doesn't exist. Not implementable.

Detection is solid (scan_output_cleanup_items exists, 200MB threshold reasonable). Fix via clean_output_items is safe (already blocks if X-Plane running). Severity 'info' correct — this is cleanup, not a problem.

Detection is speculative and HIGH FALSE POSITIVE risk. Requires parsing activity log for Windows error codes (ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION/ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED) which may not be present in error strings. Many causes for install failures besides AV. Low confidence heuristic.

Detection is sound (log analysis + file checks for ReShade.ini). Duplicates doctor.plugins.reshade_vulkan_blocked — same issue, same files. Redundant check. Fix correctly marked as not auto-fixable (destructive, requires user judgment).
Detection via check_for_updates is correct. Fix via Tauri updater is safe (signed, verified). Severity 'info' appropriate (updates are optional). Tier 'safe' accurate.
DUPLICATE of doctor.navdata.multiple_providers_conflict. Same check, same detection logic, same false positive issue (scan_navdata doesn't return multiple providers). Redundant.

Detection is sound (analyze_xplane_log extracts gpu_driver, version parsing feasible). X-Plane 12 minimum is 510 for NVIDIA (documented). Fix correctly not auto-fixable (driver updates are OS-level). Version parsing needs careful implementation (handle formats).

Detection is sound (analyze_crash_report returns loaded_modules, dll_conflict cause exists per crash_analysis.rs). Matching overlay DLL names is reliable. Fix correctly not auto-fixable (requires user to disable overlays in each app). Good check.

Detection is WEAK. runloop_backlog has many causes (plugin lag, low FPS, heavy scenery) — not specific to multi-monitor. Multi-monitor detection via WMI/registry is NEW backend work not in scope. Extremely speculative correlation with low confidence.

Detection is solid: analyze_xplane_log parses 'W/RLP: Runloop is backed up' + sample_line names the offending module. Fix requires expert judgment (update vs. disable vs. config tweak), not automatable.
Detection viable (filesystem check for xOrganizer plugin folder). No auto-fix possible—user must choose which manager to use. Severity info is correct (not breaking, just conflicting workflows).

SceneryManagerData has total_count but NO enabled_count field—detection would need to iterate entries[].enabled. The >100 threshold is arbitrary and not evidence-based; many users run 150+ scenery packs without issue on modern hardware. Low signal-to-noise.

scan_navdata_backups exists and returns NavdataBackupInfo[] with verification metadata. restore_navdata_backup is safe (size-verified atomic move). Tier=confirm correct: user picks which backup to restore.

Detection sound: if cycle.json exists but earth_nav.dat/earth_fix.dat/earth_awy.dat missing, navdata is incomplete. No auto-fix; user must reinstall via FMS Data Manager. Severity warning appropriate.

Detection logic is weak: beta builds don't always break plugins (many betas are stable), and plugin_error can occur on stable builds. This would produce high false-positive noise. Severity should be info (not actionable). Confidence=medium is optimistic.

NO parser for X-Plane.prf exists in codebase. set_xplane_preference is NEW and not implemented. Detection would require parsing pref format + correlating with log issues. Auto-fix requires is_xplane_running check + prf backup + key=value edit—complex new code. High effort, needs implementation.

Detection works (analyze_xplane_log category='negative_memory_pressure'). Severity=info correct—this is a RECOVERY message, not a problem. Confidence should be high (not low): the message unambiguously means memory pressure resolved.

clear_readonly_recursive exists in atomic_installer.rs and works on both Windows (set_readonly(false)) and Unix (chmod +w). Auto-fix is safe with confirmation. Detection needs NEW recursive scan of Aircraft/Resources/Custom Scenery for readonly files (>10 threshold). Implementation viable.

Detection trivial: after validate_xplane_path, check Resources/, Resources/plugins/, Aircraft/, Custom Scenery/ existence. Severity=critical correct (X-Plane won't run). No auto-fix possible—requires full reinstall.

gateway_check_updates exists and returns has_update=true entries. Auto-fix navigates to Scenery > Gateway page (UI navigation, not command execution). Tier=confirm correct: user selects which airports to update. Detection is sound.

check_aircraft_updates detects Zibo via ZiboInstallMode::MajorClean when major version differs. execute_aircraft_update handles automatic clean install. Fix is safe with confirmation (~1-2GB download, deletes old version). Detection and fix both implemented.

Detection logic is flawed: version strings vary wildly (some use 'dev' for developer builds, 'exp' for export, etc.). Many users intentionally run beta addons for testing. High false-positive risk. Confidence=low is accurate—this is speculative.

Detection works: analyze_xplane_log category='third_party_blocked' OR filesystem check for ReShade.ini/reshade-shaders/dxgi.dll/d3d11.dll. No auto-fix (requires manual deletion of multiple files). Severity=warning correct (blocks visual enhancements, may cause startup issues).

Detection requires NEW Windows registry read (HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM\AdvancedColorEnabled) + correlation with gfx_error in log. No HDR detection code exists. Platform-specific (Windows 10/11 only). Confidence=low is accurate—many HDR+X-Plane combos work fine.
Detection is solid (dsf_error+scenery_error in log, mapped to pack). Fix is correctly destructive—deleting scenery without user confirmation of exact tile could remove wrong data.

Detection is reliable (checking *GLOBAL_AIRPORTS* enabled field). Fix is safe—re-enabling default airports is reversible and matches existing toggle_scenery pattern. Severity critical is correct (world becomes empty).
Detection uses existing drifted field from airport_flatten_list_overrides. Fix calls airport_flatten_apply_all_drifted which regenerates apt.dat from known-good state. Safe operation, well-tested.
Detection: scan_navdata returns error if Custom Data missing. Fix is safe (mkdir). Severity info correct—X-Plane runs fine without it, just third-party installers fail.

RED FLAG: Detection is unreliable. scan_navdata only scans Custom Data (third-party), does not parse Resources/default data cycle. No NEW parsing mentioned exists. False-positive risk if user has current third-party navdata.
Detection solid (has_update from check_plugins_updates). Tier should stay 'confirm' not be promoted to safe—plugin updates can break compatibility, require user review before batch update.
Detection reliable (deprecated_dataref category exists in log parser). No fix possible—plugin source code change required. Severity info correct (low urgency, still works).

RED FLAG: Detection is weak. 'shadercache > 500MB' is not corruption signal—high-end GPUs legitimately have large caches. gfx_error correlation is tenuous. Fix (delete cache) is safe but false-positive rate too high.

RED FLAG: Detection is speculative. Beta + crash does not imply incomplete update—beta builds crash for many reasons. No 'version_mismatch' category exists in log parser (check build_patterns()). High false-positive risk.
Detection is sound (path string contains Program Files). Severity correct—causes real install failures. No safe fix possible (requires manual reinstall).

RED FLAG: Detection unreliable. scan_navdata reads cycle.json but does NOT parse cycle_info.txt validity dates. The NEW parsing mentioned does not exist in scan_navdata. Would need new command to read cycle_info.txt.
Detection is vague and low-value. normalize_xplane_version_token exists but 'unusually high/low' comparison has no baseline. Weak signal, questionable utility—user knows their update channel.
